sections.title: What It Does
sections.body: IP gets data to the right COMPUTER. The transport layer (Layer 4) gets it to the right PROGRAM on that computer — Chrome, a game, WhatsApp. It is like a courier who not only finds your building but also your exact flat number.
sections.code:
Layer 3: PC -> PC   (IP address)
Layer 4: App -> App (Port number)

sections.title: Its Main Jobs
points: Tracking conversations — each app chat gets its own session.
Segmentation — cuts big data into small pieces (segments) and numbers them so they can be rebuilt in order.
Port numbers — a label saying WHICH application the data belongs to.
Reliability (optional) — TCP can resend anything that got lost.

sections.title: Two Protocols to Choose From
sections.body: Layer 4 gives you a choice: TCP = reliable but slower (like registered post with signature), UDP = fast but no guarantees (like throwing letters over the wall). Next lessons cover both.

sections.title: Quick Facts
sections.tip: 💡 Exam tip: segments are built at Layer 4. Port numbers also live at Layer 4.
